text: In this chapter's framing, every photonic computing company can be located on a single clarifying axis defined by which two product categories?
choices: Optical compute (performing arithmetic) versus optical interconnect (moving bits)
Integrated waveguide optics versus free-space optics
explanation: The chapter's organizing axis is compute versus interconnect: optical compute performs arithmetic (matrix products, Ising minimization, convolutions), while optical interconnect moves bits (I/O chiplets, interposers, switch fabrics). Analog/digital, classical/quantum, and integrated/free-space are real distinctions but not the single axis the chapter uses to classify companies.
